name: Real estate floor plan prices from providers' own pages
description: Published prices of 24 floor plan providers for property listings (drawing services, scan platforms and DIY apps), read from each provider's own pricing page on 18 November 2026: cheapest 2D and 3D plan, monthly plans, what is free, turnaround, the size the base price covers, what you send, what the page says about measurements, the source URL and notes on comparability.
creator: October (october-ai.com)

changelog.change: First release: 24 providers, each read from its own pricing page on 18 November 2026; drawing services median $38 for a 2D plan.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The floor plan service or app, as it names itself.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The page the row was read from.

fields.name: checked
fields.description: The day the page was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Drawing service (you send photos, a sketch or a scan), scan app/platform, or DIY app.

fields.name: floor_plan_from_usd
fields.description: Cheapest published 2D floor plan, pay as you go, in US dollars (0 = free; per floor or per property as notes say).

fields.name: subscription_from_usd
fields.description: Cheapest monthly plan, where sold that way (0 = no monthly fee).

fields.name: size_limit
fields.description: Square-footage or room limit of the base price, as stated.

fields.name: input
fields.description: What you send or capture: photos, a sketch, a phone scan, a 360 camera, an on-site survey.

fields.name: measurements
fields.description: What the page says about measurements or square footage (GLA, ANSI).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything that changes comparability: per floor vs per property, per sq ft, credits, sources.

rows.turnaround: 3D model within 24h (up to 30 panoramas); 2D plan within 8h after 3D model approval; 48h over 30 panoramas
rows.size_limit: 30 panoramas in the base package (+NT$45 per extra panorama)
rows.input: 360 panoramas of each room
rows.notes: Fetched page is the Taiwan price list in NT$: package with 3D tour + 2D floor plan NT$1,800 per set; floor plan not sold separately. US page (asteroom.com/en/pricing) showed no prices.

rows.turnaround: Most redraws within 24 hours; 3D and more complex designs 48 hours
rows.size_limit: Standard service suits single residences up to six-story buildings; larger work is a custom quote
rows.input: Almost any drawing: photo of builder's plans or a hand-drawn sketch
rows.measurements: Redrawn to scale if you provide measurements
rows.notes: Page served EUR only: 2D B&W EUR 30, 2D full color EUR 35, 2D textured EUR 35, 3D full color EUR 40 per story, tailored 3D from EUR 200, floor + site plan from EUR 40. A search result title for the same URL read 'US$30 to US$40', but USD was not visible on the fetched page.

rows.free_option: Design for free, pay only on export
rows.input: Draw/AI conversion; separate Floor Plan Scanner phone app
rows.measurements: Scanner app: '2D and 3D floor plans with measurements in 4 minutes or less'
rows.notes: Price from CloudPano's own blog FAQ ('starting at $1 per 2D plan'); its pricing page returned 404. 'starting at $1 per 2D plan' stated in CloudPano's own blog FAQ; cloudpano.com/pricing returned 404, so no rate card read.

rows.free_option: App Store description: unlimited LITE 2D floor plans free for properties up to 5k sq ft; 'Redeem first scan for free'. cubi.casa/pricing: 'First 2D floor plan is free!'
rows.turnaround: cubi.casa/pricing: STANDARD and PLUS 24h, PLUS 3D 48h; 6h rush add-on (fee not shown)
rows.size_limit: LITE free up to 5k sq ft (App Store description)
rows.input: Phone scan with the CubiCasa app (about 5 to 10 minutes)
rows.measurements: LITE: room dimensions; STANDARD: total area; GLA report 'aligned with the ANSI Z765 standard'
rows.notes: cubi.casa/pricing loads prices dynamically and showed no figures for STANDARD/PLUS/PLUS 3D/rush. A 2022 developer reply on the App Store says fixed-furniture plans cost $15 per scan (may be out of date).

rows.free_option: 'It is free!': unlimited projects and floors, 3D view (with ads)
rows.input: Draw yourself
rows.notes: Android one-time purchases: Basic $4.99 (no ads, hi-res PNG/JPEG export), Full $7.99 (adds PDF/DXF/SVG export). iOS and web prices not shown.

rows.size_limit: 0-1,000 sq ft for the base price; 4,000 sq ft and above custom quote
rows.input: Existing plans, on-site survey, or Matterport scan
rows.measurements: 'All measurements provided on our floor plans are approximate'; square footage calculation is a $35 add-on
rows.notes: $190 B&W / $215 color from existing plans (0-1,000 sq ft); on-site survey $214 B&W / $239 color; tiered by sq ft. As add-ons to their 3D walk-through scan: 2D from scan $150, 2D color $200, 3D color $250. Non-90-degree walls need custom quote.

rows.free_option: 'Free for casual use': up to 5 projects, 3 floors and 3 designs each, SD exports only (watermarked)
rows.input: Draw yourself
rows.notes: One-off credit packs: 5 credits $8.15, 10 $16.30, 30 $48.90, 100 $163.00. Credits per project upgrade/HD export not shown; subscription prices rendered as $0 placeholders. Real-estate page says 'a one-time fee of a few dollars per property'.

rows.input: Zip code and square footage for the price calculator
rows.measurements: Charged on 'the actual measured area, including basements and external spaces'
rows.notes: Prices only via a calculator/price table not shown in the page text; 'Pricing may vary by area'.

rows.measurements: Marketing copy: 'every dimension and structural element is crystal clear'
rows.notes: No prices on the service page; eight styles listed (2D/3D, B&W/color, floor + site plan, custom). Contact for price.

rows.turnaround: Processed within 24 hours once all data is uploaded; not guaranteed over 10,000 sq ft
rows.size_limit: Up to 1,500 sq ft for the 'from' price
rows.input: PLANIX R1 camera ($2,599 one-time purchase)
rows.measurements: 'Accurate floor plan' and measurement tool (page does not mention ANSI/GLA)
rows.notes: Per-project prices on the page read in Canadian dollars for us (Standard from CAD 48 up to 1,500 sq ft, then per sq ft), so no USD price is recorded. iGUIDE Standard from $48 (Premium from $66), then per sq ft ($0.032/sq ft first 10,000 sq ft for Standard). Floor plan is bundled with the 3D tour, not sold alone. Requires owning the camera.

rows.input: Manual or laser-assisted measurement; LiDAR scan on iOS Pro devices
rows.notes: App Store in-app purchases: Sketch Plan $12.99/month ($129.99/yr), Report Plan $39.99/month, Estimate Plan $89.99/month. magicplan.app/pricing did not render plan prices; FAQ says plans start at 10 projects/month and extra projects cost $40 each.

Current plans page (matterport.com/plans) rendered no prices when fetched, so current price and plan prices not confirmed. Requires a Matterport plan.

rows.notes: 'Starting at $119' (currency code not stated; US site). B&W plan for each level. Exact price after entering the address. In-person measuring, so not like-for-like with photo/sketch redraws.

rows.turnaround: '24-hour standard delivery' (general claim for all services)
rows.notes: Computed from the page: 2D first floor 20 credits and 3D 40 credits, at $1.50 a credit bought on demand (less on credit packs). Priced in credits, not USD: 2D first floor 20 credits (+10 each further floor), 3D first floor 40 credits (+20). Credits cost $1.50 on demand, $1.10-$1.30 in prepaid packs. USD per plan not stated on the page.

rows.notes: Business plan ($25/month per user billed monthly as shown; $300/yr) is the plan listing '2D & 3D floor plans'. App Store IAPs differ: Pro Monthly $26.99, Basic $29.99, Business Yearly $549.99. No per-plan price.

rows.notes: Floor Plan Generator '$20/each, First order free' on Pro and Business only. Pro $39/month billed annually (no monthly-billing price shown); Business $59/month billed annually.

rows.free_option: Free download; exporting/sending plans as standard image files is free

rows.notes: In-app purchases: Full Unlock $39.99, Full Unlock (monthly) $3.99. PDF/DXF/3D exports need the subscription.

rows.input: Draw yourself; iPhone/iPad LiDAR scan; convert an existing plan
rows.measurements: Total Area feature calculates floor areas
rows.notes: $4 per 2D or 3D render on the Free plan. Pro $24/month billed monthly ($12/month billed annually, $144/yr) includes 2D renders; Team $70/month. Prices exclude sales tax/VAT.

rows.input: Blueprints and sketches
rows.notes: $38 per floor on a Free account; from $18 per floor on Pro/Team subscriptions; tagline 'from USD 20 per floor'. Per floor, not per property. AI Convert and FloorCapture $20 per floor on Free.

rows.turnaround: Most 2D plans within 48 hours, 3D within 72 hours; rush available (no time or fee stated)
rows.input: Hand-drawn sketches, photos, PDFs or existing plans
rows.measurements: Plans include 'accurate measurements, labels, and room names'
rows.notes: Priced per storey. Page shows two unlabeled prices per item (2D basic B&W $9 / $19; 3D basic $19 / $39); lower figure recorded. Color 2D $12, 2D with furniture $14, site plan add-on $5.

rows.free_option: Starter $0/month, up to 2 projects per month (per-sq-ft fees still apply)
rows.turnaround: 'commensurate with the size of the space'; rush +20%, not guaranteed

rows.notes: Priced per sq ft: residential 2D $0.18/sq ft (Starter) or $0.14/sq ft (Essentials); $10 minimum per order (recorded as from-price). Essentials $29/month for up to 5 projects.
